items.summary_en: Candidates for governor of Pernambuco held campaign events near Recife, Brazil on Friday. Raquel Lyra walked with supporters in Olinda and Itapissuma, and Joao Campos attended events in Recife and Abreu e Lima. Ivan Moraes mixed recordings with cultural and campaign events in the state capital.
